description: Evidence-based condition nutrition registry for PCOS, Male Hypogonadism, and General population safeguards based on 2023 International PCOS Guidelines, EAU 2026, and Endocrine Society Hypogonadism Guidelines.

rules.statement: Nutritional planning should follow evidence-based population dietary guidelines emphasizing a variety of nutrient-dense whole foods, adequate protein, fiber, and cultural adaptability.
rules.source_section: Chapter 1: Nutrition and Health Across the Lifespan
rules.notes: Current 10th edition (2025-2030). Source does not publish GRADE/LE scores; unassigned source grades faithfully recorded as UNREPORTED.

rules.statement: BioPulse Safeguard: Preserves Phase 5A neutral energy and macronutrient reference targets.
rules.population_description: All users in the general pathway
rules.notes: Ensures no arithmetic modification of neutral targets in general pathway.

rules.statement: Diagnosis of male hypogonadism requires consistent symptoms and signs of androgen deficiency combined with unequivocally and consistently low morning serum total testosterone levels measured on at least two separate occasions with an accurate assay. Screening questionnaires or risk assessments alone do not establish a diagnosis.
rules.population_description: Adult men evaluated for potential hypogonadism
rules.source_title: Testosterone Therapy in Men with Hypogonadism: An Endocrine Society Clinical Practice Guideline
rules.notes: Diagnostic boundary: Endocrine Society Rec 1.1 published grade '1 | ⊕⊕⊕O'. Diagnosis requires symptoms plus unequivocally and consistently low testosterone. Screening cannot establish diagnosis.

rules.statement: A nutritionally adequate, sustainable healthy eating pattern consistent with general population dietary guidelines is encouraged for overall well-being and cardiometabolic health in men evaluated in the hypogonadism pathway.
rules.population_description: Adult men evaluated in the hypogonadism pathway
rules.source_section: Chapter 1: Nutrition and Health Across the Lifespan
rules.notes: General healthy eating context from population dietary guidelines; not an EAU clinical recommendation. Zero hormone-boosting claims.

rules.statement: Weight loss obtained through a low-calorie diet and regular physical activity results in a small improvement in testosterone levels. Improve lifestyle and reduce weight (e.g. obesity); address relevant drugs/comorbidities before testosterone therapy.
rules.population_description: Adult men (age >= 19) with clinician-confirmed hypogonadism and overweight or obesity
rules.source_title: EAU Guidelines on Sexual and Reproductive Health — Male Hypogonadism
rules.source_recommendation_section: 3.4.3.c Summary of evidence and recommendations for choice of treatment for late-onset hypogonadism
rules.notes: EAU Section 3.4.3.a (lifestyle/weight-loss discussion) & Section 3.4.3.c (Summary of evidence LE 1a: weight loss through low-calorie diet and regular physical activity results in a small improvement in testosterone levels; Recommendation: improve lifestyle and reduce weight, strength rating Strong). Applies strictly to adult confirmed hypogonadism with higher weight.

rules.statement: BioPulse Safeguard: Hard prohibition of any claims that specific foods, recipes, superfoods, or diets boost testosterone, increase androgens, cure hypogonadism, or replace clinical testosterone therapy.
rules.population_description: All male users evaluated in the hypogonadism pathway
rules.notes: Hard boundary: nutrition does not replace endocrine replacement therapy.

rules.statement: BioPulse Safeguard: Preserves Phase 5A neutral energy and macronutrient targets without modifying carbohydrate, protein, or fat ratios under the guise of testosterone enhancement.
rules.population_description: All male users evaluated in the hypogonadism pathway
rules.notes: Guarantees macro immutability in the hypogonadism pathway.

rules.statement: BioPulse Safeguard: Adult male hypogonadism and late-onset hypogonadism clinical guidelines must not be applied to adolescents (age < 19). Adolescent concerns require specialized pediatric endocrinology evaluation.
rules.notes: Protects adolescents from adult hypogonadism guideline application.

rules.statement: Healthy dietary patterns consistent with general population dietary guidelines should be encouraged in all individuals with PCOS, tailored to personal food preferences, cultural background, and sustainability.
rules.source_title: Recommendations from the 2023 International Evidence-Based Guideline for the Assessment and Management of Polycystic Ovary Syndrome
rules.notes: Consensus recommendation (CR 3.3.2) advising population-based healthy eating tailored to individual preferences.

rules.statement: There is no evidence to support any one specific dietary composition over another for anthropometric, metabolic, hormonal, fertility or quality of life outcomes in PCOS.
rules.population_description: Adolescents and adults with PCOS or under screening evaluation
rules.source_title: Recommendations from the 2023 International Evidence-Based Guideline for the Assessment and Management of Polycystic Ovary Syndrome
rules.notes: Evidence-based recommendation (EBR 3.3.1) ruling out mandatory low-carb or keto prescriptions. Certainty: Very Low (⊕◯◯◯); Strength: Conditional recommendation (❖❖❖).

rules.statement: Lifestyle intervention should be recommended for all women with PCOS for improving metabolic health including central adiposity and lipid profile.
rules.source_title: Recommendations from the 2023 International Evidence-Based Guideline for the Assessment and Management of Polycystic Ovary Syndrome
rules.notes: Evidence-based recommendation (EBR 3.1.1) recommending lifestyle intervention for improving metabolic health including central adiposity and lipid profile. Certainty: Very Low (⊕◯◯◯); Strength: Strong recommendation (❖❖❖❖).

rules.statement: Dietary changes should be flexible, preference-sensitive and avoid unnecessarily restrictive or nutritionally unbalanced diets.
rules.population_description: All individuals evaluated for or diagnosed with PCOS
rules.source_title: Recommendations from the 2023 International Evidence-Based Guideline for the Assessment and Management of Polycystic Ovary Syndrome
rules.notes: Practice point (PP 3.3.3) advising flexible, preference-sensitive dietary changes avoiding unduly restrictive diets.

rules.statement: There are benefits to a healthy lifestyle even in the absence of weight loss.
rules.source_title: Recommendations from the 2023 International Evidence-Based Guideline for the Assessment and Management of Polycystic Ovary Syndrome
rules.notes: Practice point (PP 3.1.5) recognizing benefits of healthy lifestyle even in the absence of weight loss. Unassigned source grades faithfully recorded as Not applicable / Practice Point.

rules.statement: For those with higher weight, weight management can be associated with clinical improvements; prevention of further weight gain is important, and if weight loss is the goal, a tailored energy deficit may be prescribed in clinical care.
rules.population_description: Adult females (age >= 19) with clinician-confirmed PCOS and higher weight / overweight / obesity
rules.source_title: Recommendations from the 2023 International Evidence-Based Guideline for the Assessment and Management of Polycystic Ovary Syndrome
rules.notes: Practice point (PP 3.1.6): Applies strictly to confirmed adult PCOS with higher weight. BioPulse safeguard preserves Phase 5A neutral energy targets without automated deficit calculation.

rules.statement: In those who are not overweight, in adolescents, and at key life points, the focus should be healthy lifestyle and prevention of excess weight gain.
rules.population_description: Female adolescents (aged 12–18) with or screened for PCOS
rules.source_title: Recommendations from the 2023 International Evidence-Based Guideline for the Assessment and Management of Polycystic Ovary Syndrome
rules.notes: Practice point (PP 3.1.9) emphasizing healthy lifestyle and prevention of excess weight gain rather than weight loss deficits in adolescents.

rules.statement: BioPulse Safeguard: Preserves Phase 5A macronutrient and energy reference targets without imposing arbitrary carbohydrate restriction, ketogenic limits, or unproven hormone-balancing macronutrient modifications.
rules.population_description: All users evaluated in the PCOS pathway
rules.notes: Guarantees macro immutability in the PCOS pathway.

rules.statement: BioPulse Safeguard: Hard prohibition of claims asserting that specific foods or meal patterns cure, reverse, or treat PCOS, or act as an insulin-sensitizing or hormone-balancing therapy.
rules.population_description: All users evaluated in the PCOS pathway
rules.notes: Ensures no therapeutic claims are made for PCOS.
